title: Product management
outcomes: a product review naming the problem, users, outcome measure, scope, priority evidence, and assumptions
a requirements or opportunity artifact a team could build from and a stranger could verify against
inputs: the confirmed primary outcome and success measures
user evidence and market material declared as sources
minimumEvidence: every user, problem, and priority claim cites research, data, or a declared source; an unsupported claim is labeled an assumption
escalation: whether to build at all is framed as a decision for the person, never decided by the pack
a measure that cannot be observed with the sources declared is reported as unobservable and handed to the analyst or the person
